Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1278
Claimant:
Tracey Guzman
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
February 27, 2025
Claim opened for a side impact at an intersection. The claimant reports a shoulder injury and is not represented by a
lawyer. The driver is named on the policy and the claimant was in the vehicle, as confirmed by the police report and
witness statements.
March 8, 2025
Reviewed the injury against the crash mechanics. The reported shoulder injury matches the kind and force of a side
impact of this type well.
March 12, 2025
Requested medical records. They show long-standing treatment for the same shoulder condition before the crash,
and most of the current complaints appear to stem from that earlier condition.
April 16, 2025
Checked for independent confirmation of the accident. No witnesses, photos or other reports have surfaced beyond
the claimant's own account, so the collision itself rests on the claimant's statement alone.
May 21, 2025
Spoke with the claimant. The account has remained consistent throughout, and the small details added later did not
change the core story. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the damage predates the
start of coverage.
May 31, 2025
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. It is still unclear whether all of the claimed damage
came from this impact or in part from the prior condition, so the apportionment remains open.
June 4, 2025
Next steps are a request for prior treatment records and an independent medical review to address how much of the
current injury is attributable to this collision.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
